prompt: Nine separate trees in one picture, drawn in proportion to each other, seen from the front and above, lit on the left and shaded on the right, each with a brown trunk. Along the bottom, from the left: a slender poplar with a brown trunk and a narrow tall oval crown of lighter green leaves; a second stone pine with a bare brown trunk and an umbrella crown in two rounded tiers; a young oak, smaller than the others, with a short brown trunk and a small round crown of bright green leaves. They stand alone, with only the flat magenta background around and below them.
